text:
emma_ae: Escalation from TitanBank: they insist on a notarized key-proof for BYO-HSM POC and want an on-camera key ceremony demo. Also require rotation evidence chain and immutable ledger push to their auditor webhook. Need legal + security signoff on scope and cost. cc @dalia_security @ashish_se

ashish_se: Notarized attestation and a live ceremony are doable but add logistics. Questions: do they need public notary (third-party) present, or is a notarized PDF from our auditor enough? Also need clarity: do they want us to operate the orchestration or only observe while their onsite team runs the ceremony? Network path: will they expose a staging endpoint or do we bring a laptop into their colo?

dalia_security: From security POV: we can provide an attestation package (HSM model + certs + signed key-hash chain) and a notarized statement via our external auditor. If they require on-site presence, that's an extra travel/ops cost and an extended SOW. Blocker: if their policy mandates notarization before production, Legal needs to approve liability language.

mike_prod: Tech notes: supporting on-camera ceremony implies we must support a demo mode that emits tamper-evident proofs and a digest we can push to their auditor webhook (or QR code). We can reuse staging-proxy + an immutable log service. Need to test PKCS#11 interoperability and ensure no key materials are ever exported.

emma_ae: TitanBank's message: "non-exportable keys, notarized ceremony, rotation every 30 days, proof-of-rotation chain pushed to auditor webhook, no third-party escrow, and a signed notarization PDF accepted for production cutover."

ashish_se: Implementation options for the demo: (1) Remote-demo: customer performs ceremony in colo while screensharing; we stream signed proof artifacts and witness logs. (2) On-site: our engineer attends and runs orchestrator with their HSM under camera. Option 1 cheaper. For POC we suggest remote demo unless they insist otherwise.

dalia_security: Legal ask: confirm indemnity and liability limits. Also need to state in writing that Redwood never stores plaintext key material. We'll provide a CI check to prevent logging key blobs and include sample grep rules in runbook.

legal_bot: templated: "Legal: Notarized attestation and on-site services require addendum. Provide SOW line items for travel, third-party auditor fee, and extended indemnity review. Estimated lead time for legal review: 7 business days."

emma_ae: Procurement asked about pricing shape. TitanBank prefers predictable pricing and will push back on per-sign fees. Can we propose a flat enterprise BYO-HSM premium + reserved throughput tier + optional ceremony addon? 

mike_prod: Yes. Proposal: small POC fee (includes remote-demo + 1 dry-run), production contract: monthly reserved throughput (covers up to X rps), enterprise BYO-HSM premium (flat), notarization add-on (one-time per-cutover), and optional on-site engineer day-rate. For very high signing volume we can include an ops surcharge per-1M ops but mark it negotiable.

dalia_security: For the security questionnaire we should supply: HSM model & FIPS certs, vendor module hashes, runbook excerpt showing no-export flow, sample audit entries, and notarized attestation (if purchased). Example audit line we'll provide:

"2026-08-14T11:31:10Z INFO rotation proof key_id=titan-01 rotated_by=customer_ceremony proof_digest=sha256:ff12ab... notarized=true"

ashish_se: Tech checklist for POC: vendor PKCS#11 .so, HSM admin account for staging, auditor webhook endpoint, allowed IP ranges, and whether customer will allow jumpbox SSH for troubleshooting. We'll provide a minimal curl sample for the proof push:

```
curl -X POST https://auditor.titanbank.example/webhook -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"proof_id":"rot-20260814","digest":"sha256:ff12ab...","timestamp":"2026-08-14T11:31:10Z"}'
```

emma_ae: TitanBank replied: they accept remote-demo if we can demonstrate notarized PDF within the same day of the ceremony. Can we get an auditor to notarize so fast?

dalia_security: Third-party auditors usually need a day to generate notarized docs once they ingest artifacts. We can coordinate expedited path for POC at an extra fee. Legal may require an SLA for notarization time in SOW.

mike_prod: Ops note: we should simulate peak signing in staging (they asked for 800 rps spikes). We'll run a load test against their vendor module if they provide it. Also prepare automation for rotation proof capture and push.

emma_ae: Action items: (1) I will ask Titan for vendor .so, IP allowlist, and auditor webhook; (2) @dalia_security to draft security Q&A and runbook snippet; (3) @ashish_se to prepare staging-demo plan and perf estimate; (4) Legal to prepare addendum and cost lines. Timeline: POC demo next Weds, paperwork due Tue COB.

legal_bot: noted: create SOW addendum template and pricing lines. Estimated legal turnaround with expedited notarization clause: 5-7 business days.

ashish_se: One final technical constraint: if their HSM only allows local signing with no network API, remote-demo may require their operator to run a signing script and push proofs; confirm if they allow that.

emma_ae: I'll confirm. Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
